primary.title: Geometry and self-righting of turtles
primary.sample: 30 individuals, 17 species; not a population distribution

parameters.R: Complete transverse shell height divided by width; normalized dimensions 2R by 2

primary.limitations: Idealized geometry; strongest agreement for highly domed terrestrial shells. Strategy regimes are not species-specific confidence intervals. Shape is not sufficient to model animal mass distribution, limbs, terrain or self-righting dynamics.

explanation.title: The Living Gomboc
explanation.author: Adam Summers
explanation.role: Qualitative background; does not supply a texture dataset or per-species parameter distribution

application.status: Documented research prior; not yet applied to existing renders or training
application.length_ratio_mapping: H/L = R*(W/L), only when H and W use the paper's complete-shell definition
application.scan_caveat: Current canonical scan mesh Z span is not verified as complete shell/plastron height; do not silently equate it to R
application.next_model: Fit species/individual-conditioned transverse curvature and rim parameters from reviewed front/side views; sample correlated plausible shapes, keeping actual scan/photo evidence dominant
application.avoid: Do not force all turtles into a Gomboc, equate p or k to existing taper, or infer missing shell texture from these equations
application.texture_source: Reviewed, appropriately authorized real turtle photos; keep source encounter groups intact

additional_primary_dataset.title: Shell geometry and habitat determination in extinct and extant turtles
additional_primary_dataset.status: Identified only; 321.89 MB data archive not downloaded; inspect terms and species coverage before use
